name: Maya — London
axis: broad 'keep me informed' reader; tests over-filtering and generic quality

transcript.content: Hi! Tell me what kind of news you want to see.
Honestly I just want to stay informed. Big world news, UK news, some tech and science when it's interesting. I work in marketing in London so business stuff that affects consumers is good too.
Not really. Maybe less sport, I don't follow any team. And skip the celebrity stuff.
Do you prefer quick headlines or longer analysis?
A mix. Headlines for the big stuff, and one or two longer reads a day is nice.

profile.ai_profile: User wants a balanced news feed with a focus on world news, UK news, and relevant tech and science updates, while avoiding sports and celebrity news.
